_doc: Host -> what worked. Read by this skill (go straight to a known route) and by bin/fetch.sh (L2 hint). The web-unlock-guard plugin reads the same format (its tags decide its rules). Your own entries go in ~/.config/web-unlock/sites.json (or the file in WEB_UNLOCK_SITES), which is laid over this file: same host = your entry wins, whole. Plugin updates replace this file, never yours. tags: cloudflare (Turnstile or JS challenge), antibot (the site's own wall), logged (needs an account), captcha (human by design), rate-limit. route = the layer that worked: http | fetch-render | fetch-unlock | browser-automation | browser-stealth | browser-real | browser-cloud | api | human | null (nothing worked yet; 'how' says what failed). Keys match the host, its parent domains, and '*.domain' (subdomains only). 'alias_of' points one key at another.

youtube.com.how: The watch page through r.jina.ai is an empty 401 shell. Captions: yt-dlp --write-auto-sub --skip-download <url> works from a residential IP. From a datacenter IP YouTube answers 'confirm you're not a bot'; then use a transcript scraper service or a residential proxy.

reddit.com.how: curl (www and old.reddit.com, also .json) returns a shell or 403; r.jina.ai and Firecrawl refuse. Works: OpenCLI in a real Chrome (opencli reddit search "..." -f yaml), or the official API with your own app credentials.

linkedin.com.how: curl lands on the authwall; Firecrawl refuses the site. Public profiles: a LinkedIn profile scraper on Apify or a similar unlocker service.

mercadolivre.com.br.how: curl, default headless browsers and Firecrawl hit 'Hubo un error' / 'Just a moment' / a login wall. Works: a Mercado Livre scraper actor on Apify.

r.jina.ai.how: About 10 parallel requests return 429 'Per IP rate limit exceeded'. Run requests one at a time with a ~3 s pause; that passed every time.

mcp.exa.ai.how: The free Exa MCP endpoint returns 429 'free MCP rate limit' on ~8 parallel calls. One call at a time with a ~3 s pause passed 40+ searches in a row.

api.ashbyhq.com.how: Public JSON: GET /posting-api/job-board/<company-slug>?includeCompensation=true returns jobs[] with location, isRemote and compensation.

job-boards.greenhouse.io.how: curl reads the whole board with /jobs/N links. Public JSON also at boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<company>/jobs.
